name: Daridorexant
summary: Daridorexant, sold under the brand name Quviviq, is an orexin antagonist medication which is used for the treatment of insomnia. Daridorexant is taken by mouth.

pharmacology.text: Daridorexant acts as a selective dual antagonist of the orexin (hypocretin) receptors OX1 and OX2. The affinities (Ki) of daridorexant for the orexin receptors are 0.47 nM for the OX1 receptor and 0.93 nM for the OX2 receptor. Its Kb values for the human orexin receptors have been reported to be 0.5 nM for the OX1 receptor and 0.8 nM for the OX2 receptor. Hence, daridorexant is approximately equipotent in its antagonism of the orexin receptors.
pharmacology.kind: Dual orexin receptor antagonist; Hypnotic; Sedative

body.says: Tmax: 1–2 hours (delayed by 1.3 hours with food)

uses.text: Daridorexant is indicated for the treatment of adults with insomnia characterized by difficulties with sleep onset and/or sleep maintenance. The medication has been found to significantly improve latency to persistent sleep (LPS), wake after sleep onset (WASO), and subjective total sleep time (TST) in regulatory clinical trials.

sideEffects.text: Side effects of daridorexant include headache, somnolence, and fatigue.

summaryZh: 達利雷生（英語：Daridorexant）是一種屬於食慾素拮抗劑的藥品，用於治療失眠。 達利雷生由口服給藥。副作用包括頭痛、嗜睡與疲勞。 本藥物屬於雙重食慾素受體拮抗劑。 作用於食慾素受體的 OX1 與 OX2 具選擇性的雙重受體拮抗劑。
summaryZhHans: 达利雷生（英语：Daridorexant）是一种属于食欲素拮抗剂的药品，用于治疗失眠。 达利雷生由口服给药。副作用包括头痛、嗜睡与疲劳。 本药物属于双重食欲素受体拮抗剂。 作用于食欲素受体的 OX1 与 OX2 具选择性的双重受体拮抗剂。

fact.en: Most sleeping pills work by boosting GABA, the brain's main calming messenger. Daridorexant works differently, by blocking orexin, a messenger that keeps us awake.
fact.zh: 大多數安眠藥是透過增強大腦主要的鎮靜傳導物質 GABA 來發揮作用。達利雷生則不同，它是阻斷讓我們保持清醒的傳導物質食慾素。
fact.zhHans: 大多数安眠药是通过增强大脑主要的镇静传导物质 GABA 来发挥作用。达利雷生则不同，它是阻断让我们保持清醒的传导物质食欲素。
